name: Domain Atlas — Spatial Web Reader
description: Detects a domain's spatial manifest (/.well-known/spatial.json) and lets you step into the worlds it declares, within a domain or across domains, carrying a real signed-credential wallet — items, loadouts with transfer-on-loss, fungible resources, and trading-station settlement — between them. The wallet itself also opens as a real browser side panel from the toolbar button on any page, independent of whether that page declares a manifest at all — docked beside the page rather than drawn over it.
